title: How to connect PitchBook to Claude
snippet:
Click **Add custom connector** and paste in the Composio MCP server URL:
bash
```
https://connect.composio.dev/mcp
```
![Add custom connector dialog with Composio MCP server URL](https://composio.dev/_next/image?url=%2Ftoolkits%2Fclaude-cowork%2Fcustom-connector.png&w=1920&q=75)

The PitchBook MCP server is an implementation of the Model Context Protocol that connects your AI agent and assistants like Claude, Cursor, etc directly to your PitchBook account. It provides structured and secure access to private-market data on companies, deals, funds, investors, people, and service providers, so your agent can research companies, analyze investors and financing activity, track company updates, and retrieve reports or profile files on your behalf.
- **Company research:** Have your agent retrieve company profiles, industries, active investors, deals, recent financing, debt financing, service providers, social analytics, and recent profile updates.
- **Investor and fund analysis:** Let the agent review investor profiles, investment preferences, funds, active investments, limited partner commitments, and target allocations.
- **People and service provider research:** Direct your agent to gather biographies, locations, team members, affiliates, and service provider details across multiple PitchBook entities.
- **Private-market news and documents:** Instruct your agent to retrieve credit news, download credit research, save entity profiles as PDFs, and download patent or news attachments.
- **Usage monitoring:** Have your agent check the connected PitchBook account's current and remaining daily limits before running research tasks.

Claude can show **Couldn't reach the MCP server** or **Authorization with the MCP server failed** when you add the connector for PitchBook.
- Check that the connector URL is https://connect.composio.dev/mcp.
- Connectors run from Anthropic's cloud, so your device network is usually not the problem.

With a standalone PitchBook MCP server, the agents and LLMs can only access a fixed set of PitchBook tools tied to that server. However, with the Composio Tool Router, agents can dynamically load tools from PitchBook and many other apps based on the task at hand, all through a single MCP endpoint.
###
Yes, you can. Claude Cowork fully supports MCP integration. You get structured tool calling, message history handling, and model orchestration while Tool Router takes care of discovering and serving the right PitchBook tools.

## Frequently asked questions
### What is the PitchBook remote MCP server?
The PitchBook remote MCP server is a hosted Model Context Protocol endpoint at https://premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp, so AI assistants can connect to it without installing or running anything locally. PitchBook provides data on private and public capital markets, covering companies, investors, deals, and funds. Its Premium remote MCP server brings that intelligence into assistant workflows for sourcing, diligence, and market research.
### How do I connect to the PitchBook MCP server?
Add the endpoint https://premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp to any MCP-compatible client such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or VS Code. The setup snippets on this page configure each client in one step.
### Does the PitchBook MCP server require authentication?
Yes. PitchBook uses OAuth: the first time you connect, your MCP client opens a browser window to sign in and authorize access, then reuses the credentials for future sessions.
### Which transport does the PitchBook MCP server use?
PitchBook exposes a Streamable HTTP endpoint, the current standard transport for the Model Context Protocol, supported by all major MCP clients.

title: PitchBook MCP Server - Official Setup Guide
snippet:
PitchBook Premium MCP for private market data and research via Claude.
## What is PitchBook?
PitchBook pitchbook premium mcp for private market data and research via claude.. The official PitchBook MCP server provides AI agents with standardized access to PitchBook's services, enabling powerful automation and integration capabilities that enhance developer productivity and streamline workflows.
This official MCP server is maintained and verified by PitchBook, ensuring reliability, security, and up-to-date functionality. Unlike community-maintained servers, this official integration provides long-term support, comprehensive documentation, and direct vendor assistance. The server is hosted on pitchbook.com, guaranteeing secure and reliable access to PitchBook's services.

Installation Instructions
Add PitchBook to your MCP-compatible client
`https://premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp`

1
Go to Settings → Cursor Settings
2
Click "Add new global MCP Server"
3
Paste the MCP configuration into mcp.json and restart

Or manually add to your mcp.json:
`{ "mcpServers": { "pitchbook": { "url": "https://premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp" } } }`
## PitchBook MCP Server Capabilities
The official PitchBook MCP server enables AI agents to:
- Perform real-time web searches and information retrieval
- Extract and summarize content from search results
- Access up-to-date information from the web
- Filter and rank search results intelligently
- Combine multiple search sources for comprehensive answers
- Retrieve and process data from PitchBook efficiently
These capabilities make it easy for AI agents to work with PitchBook as part of a larger automation strategy, enabling seamless integration between AI assistants and your existing tools.

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that enables AI models to securely connect to external APIs, tools, and data sources. This official MCP server from PitchBook provides standardized access to their services, allowing AI agents to interact with PitchBook's platform seamlessly.

### Authenticate with Enterprise

Restart your client, confirm the server's tools appear, and run one read-only question first. Keep client-side approval prompts on for any tool that can write, trade or send. Confirm with your firm's compliance policy before connecting systems holding client data.
